interface.name: tilo_scroll_manager_v1

description.summary: horizontal scrolling a surface has no use for

interface.description: Tilo lays windows side by side in a strip. A sideways two-finger swipe or a tilted wheel over a window that has no use for horizontal scrolling moves that strip instead. The compositor cannot see what a client does with a scroll, so a client binding this global tells it: the scroll still reaches the client first, and the client hands back the ones nothing in it used. A surface without a tilo_scroll_surface_v1 keeps every horizontal scroll.

request.name: horizontal_unused

description.summary: hand the sideways scroll in progress back

request.description: The horizontal scroll this surface is receiving moved nothing in it: the first event of a finger or continuous scroll that is mostly sideways, or a sideways wheel notch, was not used. The compositor may take the rest of a finger scroll, ending it on this surface with wl_pointer.axis_stop, and use the whole of it itself; a notch it uses as is. Sent at most once per scroll. Ignored when no such scroll is in progress over the surface.
